facts.text: The Newport location is at 82A Carothers Road and lists daily store hours of 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Call 859-486-2106 to confirm current hours and pickup or assistance arrangements. These are shopping hours, not a verified pickup timetable.
quote: Store address 82A Carothers Rd., Newport, KY 41071 Get Directions Phone number 859-486-2106 Email [email protected] Store Hours* Sunday 7:00 am - 9:00 pm Monday 7:00 am - 9:00 pm Tuesday 7:00 am - 9:00 pm Wednesday 7:00 am - 9:00 pm Thursday 7:00 am - 9:00 pm Friday 7:00 am - 9:00 pm Saturday 7:00 am - 9:00 pm

facts.text: Fresh Thyme’s pickup FAQ linked in the Newport storefront offers ordering through its website or mobile app. Sign in or create a loyalty account, choose the store and add items. The page does not describe the Newport collection point, arrival check-in or loading help.
quote: There are two ways to place a pickup order with Fresh Thyme: Using our Website: Sign in or create your Fresh Thyme loyalty account. Select your preferred store and begin adding items to your cart. Using our Mobile App: Download our mobile app on the App Store or Google Play . Sign in or create your Fresh Thyme loyalty account. Select your preferred store and begin adding items to your cart.

facts.text: The chain’s pickup rules say to collect within the selected time frame and contact the store directly if late or changing an order. If the store has not heard from the customer by the end of the day, it cancels the order without processing payment.
quote: You can pick up your order within the selected time frame. If you are going to arrive late or need to change your order, please contact the store directly. If the store has not heard from the customer by the end of the day, the order will be cancelled. Payment is not processed for cancelled orders.

facts.text: The pickup FAQ allows scheduling up to two weeks ahead. A missing preferred time slot means that store has reached its pickup capacity for that period; choose an available slot. This does not confirm today’s Newport availability.
quote: Currently, pick-up times can be scheduled as far out as two weeks in advance. What if my desired timeslot is not showing? If the timeslot you desire is not available, this means that store already has the maximum amount of pickup orders during that timeframe. Please choose the next available timeslot.

facts.text: The pickup FAQ says temperature-controlled products are kept in temperature-controlled storage before collection. It does not provide storage temperatures or promise a safe storage period after collection.
quote: How will temperature-controlled products stay hot or cold? Temperature-controlled products are placed in temperature-controlled storage.

facts.text: Fresh Thyme’s pickup FAQ excludes alcohol from pickup and says CBD products can only be bought in-store. Plan for those exclusions before relying on pickup for a complete shopping trip.
quote: Can I purchase CBD products online? Not at this time. CBD products can only be purchased in-store. Can I purchase alcohol online? Not through pick-up at this time. Alcohol products can only be purchased in-store or through a delivery service provider like DoorDash, Instacart, or UberEats.

facts.text: The pickup FAQ currently linked from Newport says customers may change an order online until a team member begins picking it. It does not guarantee changes after picking starts.
quote: You can make changes to your order online anytime before a team member begins picking it.

facts.text: The chain FAQ linked from Newport directs delivery orders to DoorDash, Instacart or Uber Eats and says MyThyme coupons and deals do not apply through those partners. Delivery eligibility, a time slot and any carrying assistance still need confirmation for the actual address.
quote: To place a delivery order visit our third-party delivery partners: DoorDash , Instacart , or Uber Eats .
At this time, MyThyme coupons and deals do not apply to purchases made through third-party delivery partners.

facts.text: CTC describes Dial-A-Ride as door-to-door public transit open to any person in Clermont County and says all its buses are wheelchair accessible. Vehicle lift dimensions, weight limits and device fit are not stated on this page; discuss your equipment with dispatch.
quote: Dial-A-Ride is a door to door public transit service. Passengers must call the Dispatch office and schedule a ride on a CTC bus. The service is open to any person in Clermont County. All buses are wheelchair accessible.

facts.text: Reserve through dispatch at 513-732-7433, option 2, up to 14 days in advance. Trips are first come, first served; the scheduling office is open Monday–Friday, 5:30 a.m.–6:30 p.m. Booking does not guarantee a requested time.
quote: To schedule a ride, you can call UP TO 14 DAYS IN ADVANCE , trips are scheduled on a first come first serve basis. The scheduling office is open from 5:30 am to 6:30 pm Monday thru Friday.
Dispatch Phone Number 513-732-7433 – Press Option 2 to speak to Dispatcher

facts.text: Dial-A-Ride operates Monday–Friday, 6 a.m.–6 p.m., with no Saturday service. The operator lists closures on New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day; severe weather may also close service.
quote: Dial-A-Ride service is available Monday thru Friday 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM (NOT SATURDAYS)
CTC will be CLOSED on the below days New Year’s Day Memorial Day Independence Day Labor Day Thanksgiving Day Christmas Day
In the event of severe weather, CTC may close it’s Dial-A-Ride service for safety if this happens information is submitted to all major broadcasting networks.

facts.text: Pickup and destinations are within Clermont County. For travel outside the county, CTC can drop a passenger at a Metro bus stop inside Clermont County; Dial-A-Ride itself will not leave the county. Confirm the connecting service and transfer arrangements separately.
quote: Passengers can be picked up anywhere in Clermont County and taken to any destination in Clermont County. If a passenger wishes to go outside Clermont County, CTC can drop them off at a METRO bus stop in Clermont County, but CTC will not leave the county.

facts.text: Drivers may help passengers on and off the bus and help secure a wheelchair, but will not enter a home or business. This does not establish lifting, stair or personal-care assistance; agree the pickup location and assistance needed with dispatch.
quote: The driver may help passengers on and off the bus and may help them secure their wheelchair, but under no circumstances will a driver enter a passenger’s home or business.

facts.text: The bus may arrive up to 15 minutes before or after the scheduled pickup or drop-off time and waits five minutes at the pickup location. Allow for this window when planning appointments and outdoor waiting.
quote: The bus may arrive 15min before or after the scheduled pick up or drop off time.
The bus will wait 5 min at the pickup location.

facts.text: Passengers may bring a service animal and up to four shopping bags; each additional bag costs $1. The page does not describe driver bag-carrying assistance.
quote: Passengers who have a service animal may bring it on the bus.
Passengers may bring up to 4 shopping bags on the bus, additional bags are $1.00 each.

facts.text: The fare page lists one-way Dial-A-Ride fares of $4.75 for adults and $2.35 for people with disabilities or seniors. The disability/senior fare requires a CTC discount-fare application; exact change is required. Confirm eligibility and payment arrangements before travel.
quote: Dial-A-Ride Fares All fares are for a one way trip Adult $4.75 Student ( 13+ with a student ID) $3.75 Persons with Disabilities* $2.35 Seniors* $2.35 Children (12 and under) $2.35
To receive this fare you must fill out a discount fare application with CTC (PDF) Exact change is required

facts.text: Cancel at least two hours before a booked ride to avoid a no-show. CTC says to call about an extreme situation so it can review the case individually; this Dial-A-Ride policy explicitly does not apply to its separate ADA paratransit service.
quote: If a passenger needs to call and cancel a ride, they must call CTC at least 2 hours in advance. If a passenger fails to call 2 hours in advance, they will receive a “ No Show .”
If a passenger does not cancel 2 hours in advance because of an “extreme situation,” they must call CTC. Cases will be handled in a case-by-case basis.
This policy is not applicable to Complimentary ADA Paratransit.

facts.text: The currently linked discount-fare application asks senior applicants for a copy of a driver’s license showing age/date of birth or a Medicare card. For the disability fare, a physician must complete and sign the relevant section. These are CTC’s application requirements, not automatic approval or separate ADA-paratransit eligibility.
quote: For Senior Fare: Attach a copy of Drivers License showing age/birth date or Medicare Card.
For Disabled Fare: physician must complete and sign the lower part of this form

facts.text: The discount-fare application says the standard $4.75 one-way adult fare applies before verification and lists $2.35 after proof of eligibility is received. It accepts the form by mail to 4003 Filager Road, Batavia, OH 45103, or fax to 513-732-7490. Confirm approval before relying on the discounted fare.
quote: Clermont Transportation Connection 4003 Filager Road – Batavia, OH 45103 – 513.732.7433

Before verification, the adult fare will be the standard $ 4.75 each way. Once proof of eligibility has been received by the Clermont Transportation Connection , the fare will be reduced by half to $2.35 each way.
You may mail this form to the above address or fax it to: 513-732-7490.

facts.text: CTC’s linked brochure, marked Revised 1-2023, gives 513-732-7433 for requesting an alternative format. It also lists Ohio Relay at 1-800-750-0750. These are historical brochure instructions; confirm current format availability when contacting CTC.
quote: Revised 1-2023
This brochure is available in an alternative format, for information call 513.732.7433

facts.text: The linked January 2023 brochure treats a third cancellation made less than two hours before pickup within 30 days as a no-show. This is historical brochure wording; confirm current enforcement with dispatch instead of treating it as the current policy.
quote: Revised 1-2023
If a passenger calls under 2 hours in advance, they will receive a “Late Cancellation”. If they call under 2 hours a 3rd time within 30 days, they will receive a “NO SHOW.”

Parking on street and at YMCA. Wheelchair accessible.

Address 1356 S. Ft Thomas Ave Ft Thomas, Kentucky 41075 Phone 859-781-0602

We also shelve our collectible books, most specially wrapped, in the Great Green room. Stop in any time to visit this magical space! The only time the Great Green Room is closed is if we have a scheduled event planned.

facts.text: The shop distinguishes its linked Bookshop ordering service from in-store stock: Bookshop ships from its own inventory. Call the store for in-store availability; an online listing does not establish a local pickup order.

facts.text: Blue Marble accepts requests to order titles by phone or in person. This is an ordering option, not a promise of curbside collection, home delivery by the store or carrying assistance.

Give us a call or stop in to order a title!

address_quote: Address 1356 S. Ft Thomas Ave Ft Thomas, Kentucky 41075

facts.text: For donations of more than two boxes, the shop prefers Wednesdays, 11:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m., when its used-book team is present. Smaller donations are welcome during opening hours. This is a timing preference, not a promise of unloading or carrying help.

facts.text: The shop says neighboring Moonflower has its own opening hours and is a separate business, although they co-host events. Do not assume the café will be open during a bookstore visit.
quote: Moonflower Coffee Collection has been next door since winter 2023. We love having them as neighbors and we frequently co host events, however, they are a separate business and have their own hours.

facts.text: The city lists Council Chambers at City Hall, 10900 Reading Road. Check the current meeting calendar before traveling; a recurring timetable alone is insufficient to establish a particular meeting date.
quote: City Hall Council Chambers 10900 Reading Road Sharonville, OH 45241

facts.text: For hearing-related or other requirements to attend a council meeting, the city asks visitors to call 513-563-1144 at least one week before that meeting. The page does not specify which aids or services will be supplied.

facts.text: The council page links to live meeting viewing and says agendas are available before meetings. A viewing link does not establish captions, remote speaking rights or a substitute for arranging attendance support.

Agendas are available prior to the meetings. Minutes are available following approval.

facts.text: The tax department places its document/payment drop box outside the employee entrance, near the entrance it calls the Accessible Entrance. The box is only for tax documents and payments. Its reach height, operating force and the complete approach are not established.

Location: In front of the Employee Entrance (near the Accessible Entrance)

Hours Monday - Friday 8:30 a.m. - 5 p.m.
